Read back this synthetic session and model counters in the customer-support-cloud namespace.
Primed only the synthetic test session counter to limit 10 with 30s TTL; hosted UI displayed try again in 26 seconds, then admitted a request after expiry.

limitations: Synthetic reference orders; refunds are simulated.
Session and approval state is process memory and does not survive process restart.
Approver Queue has no role protection.
In a conversation spanning orders, the model asked for an additional confirmation of ORD-1001; supplying it completed the request.
This verifies the POC deployment, not production capacity or model accuracy on arbitrary inputs.
